items.claim: Does Vercel strip a client-sent x-vercel-isr header before _render or _isr runs?
items.consequence: If the platform strips or overwrites that header on external requests, the branch is not reachable by a caller and no finding applies. If it does not, any direct caller of _render or _isr can choose the rendered route, reopening the path override that 335a204 closed; that would be a must-fix security finding.
items.proposed_fix: Vercel platform owners or a maintainer with Vercel access can confirm whether client-supplied x-vercel-isr is stripped or overwritten on external requests to the functions. A measurement also settles it: on a deployment, send a request with x-vercel-isr: 1 and ?x_astro_path= set to a route the edge middleware blocks, and check whether that route is served.

items.claim: The change adds no test for the new x-vercel-isr branch: the PR states no test cases were added, and the existing path-override tests send only the untrusted query parameter or header, never x-vercel-isr.
